name: When should I call a professional for wind-damaged siding?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for wind-damaged siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional immediately if you notice missing siding panels, large cracks, or any signs of water intrusion after a wind event. These issues can quickly lead to more severe damage, such as water infiltration into your home's structure, mold growth, or compromised insulation. Early intervention by a restoration company can prevent minor damage from escalating into costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately for missing panels, large cracks, or water intrusion after wind damage to prevent further structural issues.
